opis: Deer's cosy home from the reference picture (the same warm walls, the round window), in warm afternoon light, now with a small round wooden table in the middle covered with a checked tablecloth. On it a round white TEAPOT with a little blue flower, three white CUPS each standing on its own white SAUCER, a spoon beside each, a plate of biscuits. Around the table the ROE DEER pours tea from the teapot, smiling as the hostess; the BEAVER holds his cup on its saucer and smiles; the MOLE, with his little HAMMER tucked under his arm, sips from his cup with happy closed eyes. A big golden STAR-shaped key hangs on a hook by the door. Calm, happy and cosy - friends together after the storm.
